DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The history of maternal non-immunity to rubella, combined with prematurity, placental insufficiency, and now clinical signs of apnea and anemia (likely due to cardiac defect like PDA or pulmonary hypertension, or bone marrow suppression), strongly suggests a congenital infection. I will confirm this suspicion by checking specific serological markers and imaging the heart.
